title: McMoneagle's CIA remote viewing of Mars a million years ago

tellings.quote: who was tasked by the CIA to remote view Mars a million years ago and described giant beings.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the CIA gave a man named Joe McMoneagle the job of remote viewing Mars as it was a million years ago. Remote viewing means trying to see faraway places or times using only the mind. Michels says McMoneagle described giant beings there, which would mean intelligent life once lived on Mars.
